headline: Baid Leasing and Finance updates physical share transfer status
summary: Baid Leasing and Finance has processed the re-lodgement of physical share transfer requests for September 2026. This is a routine administrative update regarding the company's share registry. Retail investors holding physical certificates in the company should verify their status with the registrar. This filing does not impact the company's financial performance or market valuation.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative update with no impact on share price.
